description: AC6 - Seasonal Surcharge Overrides for Contracted Accounts (Quote-UI OmniScript path)

propertySetConfig.internalNotes: UCM-52679 AC6 - resolver (via the already-proven AC1-5 pricing Flow) returns the authoritative final per-unit/total price whether or not a seasonal surcharge actually applies to this line; only falls back to the original DRT-computed split price on resolver failure (success == false), which is a defensive fallback, not business logic.
Deterministic merge key for correlating SL_SeasonalSurchargeResolver results back to this BillableAccount split row. UCM-52679 AC6.

UCM-52679 AC6 - outer per-product loop, modeled on the proven Pricing_Procedure_English_3 ProductLoop pattern, so BillableAccount split rows are resolved/merged within the correct product scope and re-nested back under Transformedproductslist per product.

UCM-52679 AC6 - re-exposes ProductLoop_Surcharge's surcharge-corrected pricing output under the Transformedproductslist key so DMTAccounttransforminIP's sendJSONPath wrapping (which names the result after the last path segment) matches the DataRaptor's existing Transformedproductslist:* mappings.

UCM-52679 AC6 - invokes the same proven seasonal surcharge resolution already used on the headless pricing path (SL_SeasonalSurchargeResolver wraps SL_8451_Salesforce_Pricing_Endpoint). failOnStepError is false so a resolver failure degrades to original split pricing rather than failing the whole quote, matching the resolver's own per-line error handling.
Recomputed independently (not reused from SetSurchargeLineKey) so this list and AccountLoop_SurchargeInput carry the identical deterministic key with no cross-step dependency ordering risk.

UCM-52679 AC6 - keyed join of this product's BillableAccount split rows with the resolver results, by the deterministic lineKey (selectedproductid:selectedAccountid). Template: advancedMergeMap pattern proven in Pricing_Procedure_English_3's Merge_oldproductslist_newproductslist / Accountsmerge steps.
